deals.title: Wireless Noise-Cancelling Headphones
deals.description: Block out the world and enjoy your music with active noise-cancelling over-ear headphones. Up to 30 hours of battery life, plush memory-foam earcups, and Bluetooth 5.3 for a stable wireless connection. A serious upgrade at less than half price.

deals.title: Smart Fitness Watch (GPS, SpO2)
deals.description: Track your steps, heart rate, blood oxygen and sleep with this lightweight fitness smartwatch. Built-in GPS, dozens of sport modes, and a bright always-on display that lasts a full week on a charge. Perfect for staying on top of your health goals.

deals.title: Running Sneakers — Breathable Mesh
deals.description: Lightweight running shoes with a breathable knit upper and a cushioned sole that keeps your feet comfortable mile after mile. A flexible, non-slip outsole works just as well on the street as on the treadmill.

deals.title: Vitamin C Serum + Hyaluronic Acid
deals.description: Brighten and hydrate your skin with this antioxidant serum, combining stabilized vitamin C and hyaluronic acid to even tone and lock in moisture. Lightweight, fast-absorbing, and suitable for daily morning use.

deals.title: Espresso Machine with Milk Frother
deals.description: Pull café-quality espresso at home with a 20-bar pump and a built-in steam wand for silky milk foam. Compact enough for any kitchen counter, with a removable water tank for easy refills. Your morning latte just got a lot cheaper.

deals.title: Anti-Theft Travel Backpack (USB)
deals.description: A water-resistant backpack with hidden zippers, a padded laptop compartment, and a built-in USB charging port. Ergonomic straps and a luggage strap make it ideal for commuting and travel alike.

deals.title: Smart RGB LED Light Strip 10m
deals.description: Transform any room with 10 meters of app-controlled RGB LED strip lighting. Millions of colors, music sync, scheduling, and voice control with Alexa and Google Home. Easy peel-and-stick installation in minutes.

deals.title: Wireless Ergonomic Mouse + Pad
deals.description: A silent, wireless ergonomic mouse shaped to reduce wrist strain during long work sessions, bundled with a comfortable gel mouse pad. Adjustable DPI and a long-lasting battery make it a desk essential.

deals.title: Facial Cleansing Massage Brush
deals.description: A gentle silicone cleansing brush that deep-cleans pores and massages your skin with soft sonic vibrations. Waterproof and rechargeable, with multiple intensity levels for all skin types.

deals.title: Non-Stick 10-Piece Cookware Set
deals.description: Everything you need to outfit a kitchen: pots, pans, and lids with a durable non-stick coating that makes cooking and cleanup effortless. Even-heating bases work on all stovetops, including induction.

deals.title: MagSafe Power Bank 10000mAh
deals.description: A slim 10000mAh magnetic power bank that snaps onto the back of your phone for cable-free wireless charging on the go. Fast USB-C wired output too, so you can top up two devices at once.

deals.title: Polarized UV400 Sunglasses
deals.description: Classic polarized sunglasses that cut glare and block 100% of UVA and UVB rays. A lightweight, durable frame and scratch-resistant lenses make them a perfect everyday pair for driving and the outdoors.
